recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 3D composition featuring a chrome-textured hand holding a microphone in a 'V' victory gesture, set against a dark void with a central red radial glow. The typography is heavily stylized with metallic bevels and a carbon-fiber-like texture on the face of the letters.
coreVisualRelationships: Hand gesture framing the central microphone
Red glow emanating from behind the hand to silhouette the form
Angular 3D text anchored below the central icon
Chrome reflections mirroring the red ambient light
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome material for the hand and mic
Red as the primary accent and glow color
Heavy 3D extrusion on all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central large-scale 3D icon occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The chrome hand and microphone assembly.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright microphone head, moves down to the large 3D title, and ends at the secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black surrounding the central glowing elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between chrome highlights and black background; high saturation in the red glow.

letterConstructionRules: Dark textured face (carbon fiber or mesh pattern)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' is significantly larger and serves as a base for the other letters
Lowercase 'the' integrated into the upper left of the main word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display type paired with a clean, wide geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide, and modern feel of the secondary text.
Provides the heavy skeleton needed for the 3D display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 3D chrome hand making a victory sign while holding a silver microphone, centered on a black background with a soft red radial glow behind the hand. The chrome should have red reflections.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D beveled text below the hand with a dark mesh face and red extruded sides. Below that, add two lines of wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif text in white and red.

verificationChecks: Is the red glow centered behind the hand?
Does the text have a clear 3D depth with red side-walls?
Are the chrome reflections consistent with the red light source?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure 3D text perspective matches the icon
Verify the red glow doesn't wash out the chrome details
Confirm the secondary text is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central 3D metallic object with a back-lit glow on a black field, anchored by heavy 3D beveled typography and wide-tracked support text.
